sources.note: Homepage confirms athenahealth provides healthcare products and services for ambulatory care. Content was JS-rendered and not fully accessible via fetch.
Mandatory disclosures URL from CHPL metadata. Page was JS-rendered and content not accessible via fetch.
athenaOne product page. Described as 'Integrated, AI-Native Healthcare Software & Services'. JS-rendered, limited content accessible.
Practice management product page. JS-rendered, limited content accessible.

FHIR R4 Implementation Guide v25.0.0 for athenaPractice and athenaFlow. Key source — lists all supported FHIR resources organized into System (16), Clinical (28), Practice Management (9), and Custom (9) resource categories. Notes that Schedule/Slot are unavailable in athenaFlow.
Summer 2025 athenaOne update blog post. Mentioned 170+ new features and enhancements. JS-rendered, full content not accessible.
Explains rebranding of Centricity Business to athenaIDX, and companion rebrandings of Centricity EDI Services to athenaEDI. Provides context on the GE Centricity acquisition heritage.

Med Tech Solutions support page for athenaPractice and athenaFlow. Confirms these are EHR/PM systems formerly from GE Centricity. Describes PM capabilities including workflows, administration, patient accounting, and revenue cycle operations.

Third-party EHR review site. Lists features including scheduling, clinical workflow, document management, lab integration, patient portal, referrals, voice recognition, billing, medical coding, denials management, authorization management, reporting, telehealth, and mobile apps.

Detailed feature breakdown: clinical documentation with specialty templates, e-prescribing with drug interaction alerts, lab order integration, telehealth, appointment scheduling with self-service, insurance eligibility verification, claims engine with payer-specific rules, denial reduction, ERA processing, patient portal, automated reminders, secure messaging, preventive care recall.
Definitive Healthcare analysis of ambulatory EHR market share. athenahealth holds ~7% market share in ambulatory EHR.
6sense market analysis showing athenahealth with 16.74% market share in EHR category. Notes majority of customers are in 0-9 employee size range.
TechTarget overview of athenahealth: cloud-based EHR, revenue cycle management, patient engagement tools, and point-of-care mobile applications for small to medium-sized practices and hospitals.
KLAS research page for athenaPractice EHR reviews. Content was behind JS rendering, specific review details not accessible.
Software Advice profile for athenaOne (athenaClinicals/athenaCollector). JS-rendered, limited content accessible.
athenaPractice and athenaFlow roadmap presentation by Chad Dodd, VP Product Management. PDF was binary-encoded and not readable via fetch.
CHUG (Community Healthcare User Group) news page for athenahealth. Provides context on the Centricity user community that transitioned to athenahealth products.
Healthcare IT News coverage of athenahealth's $5.7B acquisition by Veritas Capital and Elliott subsidiary in 2018.
Coverage of athenahealth's subsequent $17B acquisition by Hellman & Friedman and Bain Capital in 2021.
MedCode application development services for athenaPractice and athenaFlow. Confirms both products are actively supported with custom development.
Summit Software Technologies brochure for Centricity CPS/athenaPractice add-on solutions. Confirms on-premise Windows client-server architecture.
2019 CHUG presentation on what's new with Centricity Practice Solution and Centricity EMR (now athenaPractice and athenaFlow).
